basic_info.description: Smart and Stylish condo with private balcony at Opera Plaza. South facing sunny exposure. Beautiful wood flooring. Practical and spacious floor plan with built-in Murphy bad wall system. Opera Plaza is a well managed complex with numerous amenities including 24 hour private security staff, on site management, heated pool and spa, concierge, fitness center, racquet courts and more! On-site optional leased parking. Best central San Francisco location is on transit line and close to freeways. Walking distance to great restaurants and shopping in Hayes Valley. Close to major cultural venues including the Opera House, SF Jazz, and Davies Symphony Hall. Coffee shop, cinema, bookstore, UPS store and restaurants on site.
